name: ChatEntry refactor
description:
- **Request:** Refactor `ChatEntry.vue` (via the Mockups profile) so each chat entry shows basic info about executed tools — ideally just the last one — while keeping the existing option to open full details from the header.
- **Discovery:** Inspected the real events/tools components and payload shape, confirming `message.tool_events[]` (`tool`, `status`, `request`, `response`, `error`, `duration_ms`) plus `lifecycle_events[]`.
- **Proposed design:** A one-line tool strip under the (sticky) header showing the last execution — status icon, tool name, arg preview, duration, plus run totals (`4 tools · 3.2 s · 1 error`) — which expands inline into the full `ChatMessageEvents` panel; the header wrench and "Processing details" drawer remain.
- **Delivered so far:** A screen/flow outline covering strip, header trigger, drawer, loading/empty/error states, container-query viewport modes and persistence, and a mock REST contract for messages and tool events.
- **Open item:** The mockup file `mockups/chat-entry-tools.html` was only partially written — the `file_change` block was truncated mid-file, so it needs to be completed (head/tokens, `app` shell, mock server, state, render, events).
